scope: Shared skills-only source contract for Claude Code and OpenAI plugin packaging.

network_policy.redirect_policy: Reject a final host outside the allowlist. For a firmware download, reject a redirect to a different host than the selected owned mirror.
network_policy.relative_url_policy: Resolve only against the declaring owned origin. Reject protocol-relative URLs, embedded credentials, non-default ports, IP-literal hosts, data URLs, and path traversal.
network_policy.external_url_policy: Never emit, follow, cite, or copy an external URL embedded in an owned payload.
network_policy.contact_policy: Do not expose or copy person names, email fields, phone fields, messenger fields, social links, or private operating identifiers.
network_policy.competitor_policy: Do not name, compare, recommend, or repeat claims about other firmware or external updater products.

source_registry.reason: Observed product count drift and contact data.

source_registry.required_cross_check: Every selected route file, size, and SHA-256 must equal the matching current GLOBAL_CATALOG record.

dynamic_inputs.on_unknown: Return UNKNOWN and do not name a file or URL.

dynamic_inputs.origin: user plus exact global model record
dynamic_inputs.on_unknown: Ask for the exact model label or return UNKNOWN.

dynamic_inputs.origin: user observation plus Global control-board guide
dynamic_inputs.on_unknown: Stop. A model-only match is not compatibility.

dynamic_inputs.origin: user context plus exact catalog route
dynamic_inputs.on_unknown: Ask whether the route is NAND/toolkit, web update, recovery, or another published method.
Do not recommend or verify the build.

dynamic_inputs.origin: deterministic local hash calculation or user-supplied command output
dynamic_inputs.on_unknown: Provide the local hash command and wait for its complete output.
Return UNKNOWN for net revenue. Offer a clearly labeled scenario range only if the user supplies the range.
Return UNKNOWN for power cost and net margin.
Return UNKNOWN for revenue and net margin.

dynamic_inputs.origin: user measurement or explicitly selected published example
dynamic_inputs.on_unknown: Do not project uplift. Ask for measured TH/s and watts or label every selected scenario value as an assumption.
Use zero drift only when explicitly labeled as a simplifying assumption, never as a forecast.

compatibility_algorithm: Normalize the user model only to an exact published model id. Never fuzzy-match to a file.
Require exact control-board platform and install method.
Filter current default-version builds by model_id, board_platform.code, and install_method.
Accept exactly one record. Zero or multiple records is UNKNOWN.
Construct the download URL only by resolving download_path against https://vnish.global and applying the URL allowlist.
Return build id, file name, size, published SHA-256, source URL, fetched-at time, and source response SHA-256.
Do not claim safety, authenticity, ownership, or device compatibility from a checksum match alone.
verification_algorithm: Identify the exact accepted build record before hashing.
Hash the local bytes using SHA-256 without modifying the file.
Compare all 64 hexadecimal characters case-insensitively after rejecting whitespace or truncation errors.
On mismatch, stop and advise deletion or a fresh download from the exact owned URL.
On match, state only that the local bytes match the selected published reference bytes.
hard_stop_conditions: selected build is not an exact unique current catalog record
published SHA-256 is absent or malformed
a selected URL leaves the owned-domain allowlist
an owned source conflicts with GLOBAL_CATALOG on file, size, or SHA-256
the user asks for foreign firmware, foreign downloads, competitor comparison, credentials, remote access, or unattended flashing
rollback owner or rollback path is missing before an irreversible plan
